metadata.title: Centro Histórico de Salvador — blockout v1

projected.source: Deterministic projection of the WGS84 origin coordinate to WGS 84 / UTM zone 24S (EPSG:32724)

metadata.notes: Positions are local metres. For box-like blockouts, position is the mesh center. Only dimensions explicitly supported by a cited source are non-estimated. Blockout values are never official measurements.

lowerCity.source: Local datum chosen at lower elevator access

upperCity.source: IPHAN historical description: Cidade Alta approximately 65 m above the port; local blockout datum, not a surveyed point elevation

terrain.source: Provisional 2D escarpment control profiles prepared for blockout. CONDER Cartografia Sistemática 1992 REL_Curva_Nivel_L is the official contour reference to import next; profiles must not be treated as surveyed contours.
